Who We Are

BUILT FOR DRIVERS.
DRIVEN BY RESULTS.

IMONA Transport LLC is a U.S.-based OTR carrier and dispatch company dedicated to connecting professional truck drivers and owner-operators with steady, high-quality freight across all 48 contiguous states.

Based in Loveland, Ohio and fully authorized by FMCSA (USDOT 4371783 · MC-1712418), we understand the road — because we're in it with you every mile. Hands-on dispatch support, load coordination, and real-time communication so you spend less time searching and more time earning.

Whether you're a seasoned owner-operator or just getting your authority, IMONA Transport is the partner that works as hard as you do.

OUR SERVICES

From dispatch to delivery, IMONA Transport provides end-to-end logistics support designed for OTR drivers and owner-operators.

01

Over-the-Road Transportation

Long-haul OTR runs across all 48 states. Consistent, profitable loads every week — coast to coast.

Freight Hauling

We coordinate general freight and match you with loads that fit your equipment, routes, and schedule.

03

Dry Van Transportation

04
📡
Dispatch & Load Tracking

Our dispatch team finds loads, negotiates top rates, handles paperwork, and tracks your progress — you just drive.

05

Driver-Focused Support

Load planning, route guidance, rate sheet support, and ongoing communication to help you operate profitably.
